summary: LanzaTech Global, Inc. filed an 8-K to report that its joint venture, Beijing Shougang LanzaTech Technology Co., Ltd., completed an initial public offering of 40 million H Shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at approximately US$1.86 per share, raising about US$75 million. LanzaTech did not sell any shares and held an 8.38% stake post-offering. The filing is a routine disclosure of a portfolio company's IPO, not a special situation for the registrant. No special-situation category applies.
